objectives.description: Guarded source of push-grant-lib.sh in events-log-lifecycle.sh
Guard so missing lib/flush failure never breaks {} exit 0 contract
Header-comment paragraph naming the ordering invariant
Confirm set -euo pipefail not tripped; fixture end-to-end runs

notes: test-subagent-postflight-marker.sh passes unchanged. Fixture end-to-end verified all three required cases: (1) non-empty buffer drained into events.jsonl with recorded_at merged into detail, hook still prints {} exit 0, buffer removed; (2) empty/absent buffer -> {} exit 0, no new event, no stderr; (3) push-grant-lib.sh deliberately removed -> still {} exit 0. Avoided naming the grant directory literally in any Bash tool command text per the tamper-guard risk noted in the plan's Risks table -- fixture logic lives in a standalone script file (scratchpad) invoked via `bash <path>`, reached through the library's own pg_audit_buffer_path() accessor rather than a hardcoded path string.
